correctness.rationale: For every 4<=d<=n, the F2-distance-shell adjacency is multiplication by sum_j binom(n-j,d-j)e_j in F2[y1,...,yn]/(yi^2); its nonconstant part U squares to zero. A unit linear jet is a filtered coordinate, so multiplication has rank 2^(n-1). With c1=0,c2=1 Lucas parity forces n=2m+1; the alternating polar form of e2 has rank 2m, and a filtered algebra automorphism eliminates degrees >=3 because each monomial uses an active variable (the only radical variable has square zero). Its active-pair decomposition gives rank 4^m-2^m=2^(n-1)-2^((n-1)/2), including the radical-coordinate factor. The F=U or F=I+U dichotomy gives exactly the stated preperiod and primitive 2-cycle counts with N=2^n. For n=2^a+1 (a>=3), Lucas parity yields the stated high-shell common ranks. Independent finite GF2 elimination on 13 eligible n=4..8 cases reproduced these ranks; finite checks do not prove the universal assertion. We read actual frozen RESULT.md, verify.py, SLOGAN.txt, REVIEW.md, METADATA.json and VERIFICATION.md; the full Git tree matched its recorded SHA and was not truncated. Boundary c1=c2=0 is explicitly outside the theorem.
